How much is a used Nintendo Switch Lite worth?

The Switch Lite is cheap to buy and easy to ship, which makes it a popular flip. The catch is that its controllers are built in, so one fault affects the whole console.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The Switch Lite (model HDH-001) is handheld only: no detachable Joy-Con and no TV output. It comes in several colours and some special editions. It is a different product from the Switch and Switch OLED, with a lower price.

What decides the price

  • Stick drift: the sticks cannot be swapped like Joy-Con, so drift lowers the price a lot.
  • Screen: scratches and pressure marks.
  • Colour and edition: special editions can sell for more than the standard colours.
  • Charger: many are sold without one. It is cheap to replace, but buyers still pay less.

Check before you buy

  • Calibrate both sticks in System Settings and watch for movement when you let go.
  • Press every button, including the D-pad and shoulder buttons.
  • Check the battery: charge it and play for a few minutes.
  • The seller should remove their Nintendo Account.

Where it sells best

Small and light, so shipping is cheap. Sells well on Vinted and eBay, often with a game or a case. Price the console on its own first, then decide if the extras are worth listing separately.

Today's price

Questions

How much is a used Nintendo Switch Lite worth?

It depends on stick drift, screen, colour and charger. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Nintendo Switch Lite" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Can a Switch Lite with drift still be sold?

Yes, but for much less, and you must describe the fault. Some buyers repair them, so faulty consoles still find buyers as "for parts or repair".

Is the Switch Lite worth less than the Switch?

Yes. It is a cheaper console without TV output, so used prices are lower as well.
